tests: the fightable-share rule replacing the all-or-nothing venue test
change_under_test: A member could only train in an area if it could engage the whole typical band. That was too strict by a wide margin: measured over 164 Mansion encounters a level-30 member can fight 71% of what it meets there and a level-28 member 40%, and both were locked out. A venue now qualifies when at least a quarter of its band is fightable, the rest being what fleeing is for.

assumed_party.source: the party the previous run actually produced, not the older receipt

predicted.mansion_block_outcome: trains, where it previously stopped at once
predicted.first_trainee: slot 4, level 30 — the weakest member that can meaningfully fight a 28-34 band
predicted.escort: not trained; at level 55 it is exactly at the floor and excluded
excluded_and_why: slot 2 at level 20: can engage 0% of the band
slot 3 at level 26: 0% — a ceiling of 28 reaches only the very bottom
predicted.then: the two level-30 members train toward the floor of 55. Once both reach it, nobody is left who both needs training and can train here, so the block stops again and names digletts_cave for the level-20 member.
predicted.expected_final_stop: 'No party member can train here' naming digletts_cave, but only after real battles rather than before any

what_would_refute_this: Zero battles again — the share rule is not reaching the live selection
The escort is trained — the floor exclusion has stopped binding
A level-20 or level-25 member is put in front — the share estimate is wrong at the bottom of the band, where it matters most
Battles occur but levels do not rise — the members are fighting and losing, meaning the +2 margin is too generous
A faint — +2 is unsafe and the margin needs to come down
honest_limit: This trains two of the five members that need it. Three sit below the Mansion's reach and still have nowhere to go until Diglett's Cave has an implemented heal-and-return. The prediction is that this run makes real progress and then stops for the same reason as before, further along.
cost: the previous run took 367 seconds to reach this point; training will make it longer, and how much longer is itself worth recording
